riskLimits: Package identity/version and optional declarations are inspected. primarySource.observedPurpose: RustCrypto universal hash function traits; not evidence of RSA/JWT implementation.

newFinding.mechanism: Unanchored RSA alternative matches substring inside universal-hash. Name alone wrongly labels this UHF-traits dependency as RSA/JWT/quantum-vulnerable.
newFinding.impact: One warning among current11; historic source/rule inventory and exact counts are retained. This is a classification error, not a cryptographic weakness in universal-hash.
newFinding.nextAction: Prepare a compatibility impact assessment for exact package-name matching and positive/negative controls if a product/rule repair is authorized. No task creation or acceptance waiver.
newFinding.humanBoundary: Rule changes that could break compatibility require human review under AGENTS.md; assessment records the defect without modifying rules.
